### ![version](./icons/icn_version.png) Added a Pack's favorite colors * Thanks in woc_Colours, to the new **woc_alColors** widget. You can add colors in the Pack Entity. * Thanks to new **woc_alColorsIdx** widget, then into Banks you choose a main "Primary colors" as the source of all the colors "dcox" chain: you change the main colors of a Bank in a snap ! * When an index is not defined, the Primary colors is by default (Black&White). * The dcox chain is now : Primary colors, SETS_Template dcox, SETS dcox, MEDIA_Template dcox, MEDIA dcox -> to your asset colors. ### DASHBOARD: default Shapes * Added for the default shape & Glyph into Sēmippān * for all Colors widgets used * for all colors used into Lists display
